picks.title: VOCALOID7 Officially Announced Just 6 Months After Hatsune Miku's V6 Debut
picks.rationale: Yamaha's VOCALOID7 ships a second-generation VOCALOID:AI singing engine on Nov 11 ($129), with AI Megpoid at launch and Miku V6 voicebanks planned. It is a concrete new release of a core vocal-synthesis tool.
picks.excerpt: Yamaha announced VOCALOID7 with a second-generation VOCALOID:AI singing engine, on sale Nov 11 ($129); AI Megpoid is the launch voicebank and Miku V6 VOCALOID7 voicebanks are planned.

picks.title: UMG & Sony Demand DistroKid Tell How Many AI Songs It Uploads From Suno: 'Staggering Scale'
picks.rationale: A new court filing: UMG and Sony ask a judge to compel DistroKid to disclose how many Suno-made tracks it pushes to streaming services. The labels' Suno litigation is now reaching the distribution layer.
picks.excerpt: Universal Music Group and Sony Music asked a judge to force DistroKid to disclose how many AI songs it uploads from Suno to streaming services - a new discovery fight in the labels' Suno litigation that targets the distribution pipe for AI tracks.

picks.title: Duke Sanford study explores AI-music encounters on Spotify
picks.rationale: Duke's Tech Policy Program ran its own AI-music detection to measure how often Spotify listeners actually run into AI tracks. It is new independent data on a question the platforms are not answering themselves.
picks.excerpt: 'Spotify won't label AI music. We tried to detect it ourselves': the Duke Sanford Tech Policy Program ran its own detection to measure how often listeners actually encounter AI-generated tracks on Spotify.

picks.title: Spotify labels AI artists after Bureau investigation
picks.rationale: Spotify's 'AI Persona' badges are now live worldwide on synthetic acts such as Bones, days after TBIJ questioned the policy. This is the rollout itself, not the August announcement, and it follows the Deezer and YouTube Music labelling moves.
picks.excerpt: Spotify's 'AI Persona' badges are now visibly rolling out globally, with Bones among the labelled acts, days after the Bureau of Investigative Journalism questioned its synthetic-artist policy.

picks.title: Who's Buying All These Vibe-Coded Plugins?
picks.rationale: A market long-read on whether AI-built audio plugins are actually selling, with two developers explaining how they use AI to build plugins. It is a demand-side look at the trend, separate from the Google vibe-coding tool story of 10-10.
picks.excerpt: Vibe-coded plugins are everywhere, but are they actually taking over the market? Attack looks at the trend and talks to two developers who use AI as part of their plugin-building process.

https://www.billboard.com/pro/umg-sony-d.new_action: New discovery motion filed 10-16: UMG and Sony ask the court to compel DistroKid to disclose the volume of Suno-generated uploads it distributes (the 10-11 card covered DistroKid's quiet takedowns; the 09-20 card covered UMG's valuation claim).

https://www.thebureauinvestigates.com/st.new_action: Spotify's 'AI Persona' badges are now visibly rolling out worldwide on named synthetic acts. This is the live deployment, distinct from the August policy announcement, which is outside the 30-day digest.
